title.zh: What happened to HTX’s 700 million missing TRX?
title.en: What happened to HTX’s 700 million missing TRX?

current_state.zh: Protos investigates roughly 700 million TRX (~$238M) that disappeared from HTX's proof-of-reserves, tracing much of it to a Justin Sun-owned Poloniex Super Representative address and Binance, while HTX also reduced disclosure for over $1B in other assets to an undisclosed custodian.
